question: Missense mutations in which genes cause X-linked developmental and epileptic encephalopathy?

supports.quote: GRIA3 missense mutation is cause of an x-linked developmental and epileptic encephalopathy.
Missense variants in the N-terminal domain of the A isoform of FHF2/FGF13 cause an X-linked developmental and epileptic encephalopathy.

initial_executor.limitations: Evidence is limited to specific missense variants in GRIA3 and the N-terminal domain of the A isoform of FHF2; other genes or mutation types causing X-linked developmental and epileptic encephalopathy are not addressed in the provided text.
